title: Elixir of Half-Elven Healing
summary: Heal yourself and nearby allies immediately.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Heal yourself and nearby allies immediately.
fields.Reported healing: The tooltip gives the drinker’s Constitution score. The pinned source reports actual healing of 1d20 + Constitution modifier.
fields.Acquisition: Trade half-elf blood to Araj Oblodra.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
